description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates the value. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.
The instance ID of the Express Connect circuit instance.

description.zh:
物理专线所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit. 

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query region IDs.

descriptions.zh: 只能删除**Allocated**、**Confirmed**、**Rejected**、**Canceled**、**AllocationFailed**和**Terminated**状态的物理专线连接。
descriptions.en: You can delete only Express Connect circuits that are in the **Allocated**, **Confirmed**, **Rejected**, **Canceled**, **AllocationFailed**, or **Terminated** state.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc delete-physical-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --physical-connection-id pc-119mfjzm7000000000 --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0016e04115b --region cn-hangzhou
